note: Rewritten from the English diagnostic characters of the entry for species 51 in State Fauna Series 8: Fauna of Gujarat (ZSI); the original is a diagnostic description under a new combination, covering the soldier and the worker; the alate is not described. Type locality the village of Vijarkhi, 15 km south of Jamnagar, Gujarat, India; the soldier holotype is in ZSI Calcutta. The measurements are translated verbatim from the original; the original left mandible length 0.74—5.78 mm and postmentum maximum width 0.44 0.47 mm have obvious OCR omissions; the former is left unchanged and the latter is supplied as 0.44—0.47.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule yellowish brown, oval, the posterior margin broadly rounded, fontanelle indistinct, antennae 16-segmented; mandibles short and thick, strongly incurved, the left mandible with a sharp tooth situated near the apical third. Worker monomorphic, head capsule yellowish brown, nearly square, the rest of the body straw yellow, antennae 15—16-segmented. The pronotum is saddle-shaped in both soldier and worker.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown, oval, the posterior margin broadly rounded; fontanelle indistinct. Head length with mandibles 1.81—1.94 mm, head length (to the mandible base) 1.06—1.19 mm, maximum head width 1.03—1.13 mm; total body length 3.94—4.65 mm. Antennae 16-segmented, segment 1 longest, segment 4 shortest, apical segment oval. Labrum ligulate, length 0.28—0.33 mm, width 0.23—0.28 mm. Mandibles short, robust, deeply incurved; left mandible length 0.74—5.78 mm (thus in the original; the upper limit is evidently an OCR error), with a medium-sized, sharp, forwardly directed tooth situated near the apical third, the distance from the tooth to the mandible apex 0.22—0.28 mm, mandible-tooth index 0.27—0.32; the right mandible about as long as the left, with a small vestigial tooth before the middle. Postmentum short, length 0.47—0.50 mm, maximum width 0.44—0.47 mm (postmentum index width/length 0.88—0.94). Pronotum saddle-shaped, maximum length 0.50—0.56 mm, maximum width 0.81—0.88 mm. Cerci 2-segmented, short, 0.11 mm long; styli single, fused, short, 0.07 mm long.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Monomorphic. Head capsule yellowish brown, the rest of the body straw yellow. Total body length 4.31—4.90 mm. Head capsule nearly square, head length with mandibles 1.75—2.14 mm, maximum head width 1.26—1.33 mm. Antennae 15—16-segmented, segment 1 longest, segment 3 shortest, apical segment oval. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.35—0.49 mm, maximum width 0.63—0.77 mm. Abdomen elongate-oval, hairy. Cerci 2-segmented, short, 0.07 mm long; styli unsegmented, short, 0.08 mm long.
